text:
alex: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a staggered deprecation of the /v1/chat and /v1/generate endpoints starting Mon 2026-04-06. Need owners for each consumer group + any hard blockers. Rollout plan below.

linh: I can own mobile SDK migration. ETA for initial patch: 2 weeks. Will need a compatibility shim for iOS older runtimes.

migs: What's the canary window and rollback criteria? Also dependencies on SDK release cadence.

alex: Canary windows: 48h at 10% then 24h at 25% then 4h at 100% for each consumer cluster. Rollback if error rate > 1% or p95 latency > 2x baseline. Docs snippet: 

alex: ```bash
# set canary
redwood rollout canary --endpoint /v1/chat --percent 10 --cluster mobile
# check health
redwood rollout status --endpoint /v1/chat --cluster mobile
```

rachel: I'll take search and reranking service. Need model fallback config confirmed (v2->v1 fallback?).

alex: No automatic v2->v1 fallback — prefer explicit rollback. We can set model-variant fallback per-route, but that adds complexity. Let's discuss on call if you need it.

paulp: Product wants a migration flag to disable new features per tenant. I can coordinate feature flags.

migs: Will SDK bump be backward compatible? If not we need a deprecation notice in changelog and client library major bump.

linh: For mobile iOS we can keep runtime compatibility if server maintains response shape for 30 days. Need explicit contract tests.

sre-bot: Scheduled maintenance note: We'll enable canaries on 2026-04-06 10:00 UTC in eu-west-1. Pager escalation: if error rate spike >1% persist for 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout job created: job/rollout-1970012345-mobile-10pc.

alex: Action items:
1) Owners: mobile=@linh, search=@rachel, plugins=@migs, product-flags=@paulp, infra-oncall=@alex
2) Linh & infra: add contract tests + canary health dashboards
3) Product: send tenant migration notice draft by EOD Thu
4) SRE: ensure rollback playbook is up-to-date

Ping owners to confirm :eyes:

linh: Confirmed. Adding tests now. :thumbsup:

rachel: Confirmed, will add variant toggles in search service.

migs: I'll draft SDK compatibility note.

paulp: Drafting email, will share.

alex: Thanks — if anyone else depends on /v1 endpoints, reply here with owner + blocker. Otherwise I'll post the runbook link tomorrow. :pray:
